definitions.definition: Applied thought: thinking, directing (ūhana); its mark is directing consciousness onto the object, function striking and threshing, manifestation leading consciousness onto the object; like the striking of a bell, the first stirring like a bird spreading its wings (Vism IV p. 142-143).

definitions.definition: Sustained thought: roving, continued moving about; its mark is continued pondering of the object, function keeping the conascent states on it, manifestation the binding of consciousness to it; subtler, like the ringing of the bell, the bird gliding on outspread wings (Vism IV p. 142-143).

definitions.definition: Rapture: so called because it refreshes; mark endearing, function refreshing body and mind or pervading, manifestation elation; fivefold: minor, momentary, showering, uplifting, pervading (Vism IV p. 143-144).

definitions.definition: Happiness: so called because it makes easy and gulps down or digs out bodily and mental affliction; mark gratification, function enhancing the associated states, manifestation aiding; distinguished from rapture as the gladness at getting a desirable object versus the experiencing of what is got (Vism IV p. 145).
